messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "store liquid medicine in an upright position"
set: ["store liquid medicine in an upright position", "store liquid medicine in the refrigerator; do not freeze", "measure liquid medicine carefully", "liquid form is an oral suspension", "store in original bottle", "store in a dry place", "different medicine may be an option", "measure liquid medicine with supplied measuring device", "do not allow liquid medicine to freeze", "measure liquid medicine with dosing syringe or medicine dose-measuring device", "store the oral liquid at room temperature and keep it in a tightly closed bottle", "measure liquid medicine with the dosing syringe provided", "store in dry place away from moisture", "do not store in any other container", "measure liquid medicine with special dose-measuring spoon or cup", "take liquid medicine on an empty stomach at least 1 hour before a meal or 2 hours after a meal"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
